```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE for between-subject 2 x 2 factorial design without interaction in R
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB 
##
## Tests:
##   1. Factor A main effect
##   2. Factor B main effect
##
## Permutation:
##   Synchronized permutation test
##   subject-level design labels are permuted once per permutation
##   and reused for all Channel x Time points
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/03_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read_csv("../data/03_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject     = factor(Subject),
    Channel     = factor(Channel),
    FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
    FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function: compute t-map for one effect
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_2x2 <- function(data, effect_name) {
  
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    summarise(
      t_value = coef(summary(
        lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB)
      ))[effect_name, "t value"],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  tvec <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time    = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tvec,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_ObsA <- compute_tmap_2x2(dat, "FactorA")
t_ObsB <- compute_tmap_2x2(dat, "FactorB")

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_ObsA <- tfce_transform(
  t_ObsA,
  E  = 0.66,
  H  = 2,
  dh = 0.1
)

TFCE_ObsB <- tfce_transform(
  t_ObsB,
  E  = 0.66,
  H  = 2,
  dh = 0.1
)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")
  
## ========================================================
## Step 3: Synchronized permutation test
##
## For Factor A:
##   permute FactorA within strata of FactorB
##
## For Factor B:
##   permute FactorB within strata of FactorA
##
## For Interaction:
##   permute full 2 x 2 cell labels across subjects
##
## The same subject-level permutation is reused for all
## Channel x Time points.
## ========================================================
  
set.seed(123)
  
nPerm <- 999
TFCE_permMaxA <- TFCE_permMaxB <- rep(NA_real_, nPerm)
  
cat("Step 3: Starting synchronized permutation testing...\n")
  
for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
  #-----------------------------------------------
  # for factor A
  #-----------------------------------------------
  perm_designA <- designTable %>%
    group_by(FactorB) %>%
    mutate(
      FactorA = sample(FactorA)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  perm_datA <- EEGlong %>%
    left_join(perm_designA %>%
                select(Subject, FactorA, FactorB),
              by = "Subject") %>%
    mutate(
      Subject     = factor(Subject),
      Channel     = factor(Channel),
      FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
      FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB)
      )
  
  t_perm_A <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_datA, "FactorA")
  
  TFCE_perm_A <- tfce_transform(
    t_perm_A,
    E  = 0.66,
    H  = 2,
    dh = 0.1
  )
  TFCE_permMaxA[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm_A), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  #-----------------------------------------------
  # for factor B
  #-----------------------------------------------
  perm_designB <- designTable %>%
    group_by(FactorA) %>%
    mutate(FactorB = sample(FactorB)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  perm_datB <- EEGlong %>%
    left_join(perm_designB %>%
                select(Subject, FactorA, FactorB),
              by = "Subject") %>%
    mutate(
      Subject     = factor(Subject),
      Channel     = factor(Channel),
      FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
      FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB)
      )
  
  t_perm_B <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_datB, "FactorB")
  TFCE_perm_B <- tfce_transform(
    t_perm_B,
    E  = 0.66,
    H  = 2,
    dh = 0.1
  )
  
  TFCE_permMaxB[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm_B), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (p %% 50 == 0) {
      cat("Permutation", p, "of", nPerm, "\n")
    }
}
  
cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")
  
## ========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ========================================================
  
cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")
  
alpha <- 0.05
  
maxTFCEA <- sort(c(
  TFCE_permMaxA,
  max(abs(TFCE_ObsA), na.rm = TRUE)
))

maxTFCEcritA <- maxTFCEA[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskA <- abs(TFCE_ObsA) >= maxTFCEcritA

P_ValuesA <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = nChan,
  ncol = nTime,
  dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsA)
)

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    
    P_ValuesA[ch, t] <-
      (sum(maxTFCEA >= abs(TFCE_ObsA[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}


maxTFCEB <- sort(c(
  TFCE_permMaxB,
  max(abs(TFCE_ObsB), na.rm = TRUE)
))

maxTFCEcritB <- maxTFCEB[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskB <- abs(TFCE_ObsB) >= maxTFCEcritB

P_ValuesB <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = nChan,
  ncol = nTime,
  dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsB)
)

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    
    P_ValuesB[ch, t] <-
      (sum(maxTFCEB >= abs(TFCE_ObsB[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}
  

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value for B  = %.4f\n; Critical TFCE value for B  = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcritB, maxTFCEcritB))

Results <- list(
    ObsA          = t_ObsA,
    TFCE_ObsA     = TFCE_ObsA,
    TFCE_NullA    = TFCE_permMaxA,
    maxTFCEcritA  = maxTFCEcritA,
    P_ValuesA     = P_ValuesA,
    MaskA         = MaskA,
    
    ObsB          = t_ObsB,
    TFCE_ObsB     = TFCE_ObsB,
    TFCE_NullB    = TFCE_permMaxB,
    maxTFCEcritB  = maxTFCEcritB,
    P_ValuesB     = P_ValuesB,
    MaskB         = MaskB,
    
    alpha        = alpha,
    nPerm        = nPerm,
    model        = "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB",
    test         = "A and B",
    permutation  = "Synchronized permutation of subject-level 2 x 2 design labels",
    times        = times,
    channels     = channels
  )
  
return(Results)


## ==========================================================
## Helper plotting function
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map <- function(mat, title) {
  
  fields::image.plot(
    x = times,
    y = seq_len(nChan),
    z = t(mat),
    xlab = "Time (ms)",
    ylab = "Channel",
    main = title,
    axes = FALSE
  )
  
  axis(1, at = seq(-200, 800, by = 200))
  axis(
    2,
    at = seq_len(nChan),
    labels = channels,
    las = 2,
    cex.axis = 0.6
  )
  box()
}

## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================

mA <- Results$ObsA
mA[!Results$MaskA] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mA, "TFCE-corrected Factor A Effect")

mB <- Results$ObsB
mB[!Results$MaskB] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mB, "TFCE-corrected Factor B Effect")

## ==========================================================
## Plot observed TFCE maps
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(
  Results$TFCE_ObsA,
  "Observed TFCE Map: Factor A"
)

plot_eeg_map(
  Results$TFCE_ObsB,
  "Observed TFCE Map: Factor B"
)

## ==========================================================
## Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(
  Results,
  file = "../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData"
)

cat("\nTFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis completed.\n")
cat("Saved results: ../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData\n")
```
